controls.name: blink

controls.description: Optional independent right blink, combined with global closure using max.

neutral.label: Netral
neutral.intent: Exact approved neutral; all controls reset to their neutral defaults.

senang.label: Senang
senang.intent: Restrained happy expression, original identity unchanged.

kaget.label: Kaget
kaget.intent: Small surprise, not exaggerated replacement eyes/mouth.

mikir.label: Mikir
mikir.intent: Restrained asymmetric interest; optional head/hand gesture is future posing only.

semangat.label: Semangat
semangat.intent: Energetic but recognizable; endpoint needs visual approval.

presetValuesAre: Proposed normalized starting weights only; not implemented or visually approved performance endpoints.
neutralReset: Reset every driven transform/morph to approved rest before sampling absolute frame state. Neutral preset leaves all values at defaults.
combinationRules: Interpolate expression weights from neutral; keep morph weights bounded 0..1.
Normalize competing mouthSmile/mouthOpenSmall/mouthThought budgets to avoid uncontrolled combined expansion.
Blink overrides eyeWide; independent closure=max(globalBlink, sideBlink).
Eye direction is independent from emotion presets; pupils and glints travel together.
Never move or recolor approved jaw/blush/face skin to fake an expression.
gazeSafety: Derive separate left/right/up/down margins from actual pupil+glint and eye-white local bounds. Limit travel to ~80% of each available directional margin; do not assume symmetric travel or let glints escape white.
exportImplementation: Planned head-attached transform nodes for gaze/brows, fixed-topology morphs for lids/mouth; no Blender-only drivers at runtime. Bake only after approval.
futurePerformanceAcceptance: all five expression endpoints reviewed against concept
blink fully closes without white/glint leakage
small mouth motion stays on face plane without z-fighting
same frame identical after arbitrary seeking
